mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as observed in historical monetary policy easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0% over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy recovers from a recession.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0% over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 (index) signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate output and earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 90.0 over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong economic expansion regime (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% in the prior quarter), corporate earnings growth is robust, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in sustained economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signal a 'stagflation' risk where the Federal Reserve is constrained in policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors fear both inflation and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% over the last 5 years.
